item.title: Leh-Bound SpiceJet Flight Returns to Delhi After Technical Snag
item.description: NEW DELHI: A Leh-bound SpiceJet aircraft returned to New Delhi on Tuesday morning following a technical issue, sources said. The Boeing 737 aircraft was operating flight SG121 from Delhi to Leh with around 150 passengers on board. Shortly after takeoff, the crew decided to return to the national capital as a precaution. item.title: Markets slump nearly 1% on IT rout; Donald Trump tariff worries hit investor sentiment
